title: Siren of the Lost Melody
description: A woman in a flowing blue dress stands on a rocky outcrop by the sea, holding a glowing red orb as musical notes float from her hands. A grand piano and a cello are partially submerged in turbulent turquoise waves beside her, while a large orange Mayan pyramid rises from the ocean in the background under a dramatic cloudy sky filled with floating transparent bubbles containing miniature scenes.
prompt: A woman in a long flowing blue dress stands on coastal rocks holding a glowing red orb, musical notes and staves swirling around her. A grand piano and cello are half-submerged in crashing turquoise waves. In the distance a large orange step pyramid rises from the sea. Dramatic cloudy sky filled with transparent bubbles containing tiny scenes of trees, tents and figures. Vibrant surreal fantasy scene.
